GH-PAGES-ADMIN.title: Pages settings API permissions
GH-PAGES-ADMIN.scope: Updating Pages settings requires Pages write AND Administration write plus an appropriate repository role; a successful update returns 204 No Content. The current app received 403, and no settings change is claimed.

GH-ACTIONS-RUNTIME.title: Actions Node20 deprecation and Node24 migration

GOOGLE-SITEMAP.title: Build and submit a sitemap

W3C-258.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum), Level AA
W3C-258.scope: Targets should be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, except where sufficient spacing or an equivalent control exists.
